title: November LA Biotech Hike: Mission Point Loop in Granada Hills
description: Join LA Biotech Hikes for a hike, breakfast, and Bollywood dancing.
long_description:
Join LA Biotech Hikes for a hike, breakfast, and Bollywood dancing.

About this Event

🌿 Double the fun, double the energy this November with the LA Biotech community!
Join us for an energizing hike led by Keuna Jeon from the Terasaki Institute as we explore a new trail in Granada Hills! With a moderate challenge and approximately 1,420 feet of elevation gain, this hike promises a great workout, followed by a chance to catch our breath, refuel, and connect over breakfast. 🥾☕🥞
💃🕺 Keep the energy going with Bollywood dancing (4p.m. - 6 p.m.) in Long Beach!
After the hike, join Anuksha Arsh Gulati from Amgen as she gets us moving to the vibrant beats of Bollywood dance! Whether you join us for the outdoor adventure, an afternoon boogie, or both, come connect with the LA Biotech community, recharge, and leave feeling energized and inspired.
👉 Bollywood RSVP: https://partiful.com/e/ZOhFgv43He7jESqxwcqT
🥾 The Hike: Mission Point Trail Loop
📍 O’Melveny Park | Granada Hills, West San Fernando Valley
17300 Sesnon Boulevard, Granada Hills, CA 91344
📅 Sunday, November 8
🕢 Start time: 7:45 a.m.
🥾 Distance: Approximately 5 miles
⛰️ Elevation gain: Approximately 1,420 feet
💪 Difficulty: Moderate
🙌 A special shout-out to our hike leader, Keuna Jeon!
Thank you, Keuna, for leading the way and bringing our LA life sciences community together, one trail at a time. We’re excited to hit the trail with you! 👏🌄
☕🥞 And, of course, breakfast and great conversations await!
After the hike, we’ll head to Casa de Nati for breakfast, good company, and more opportunities to connect.
📍 15456 Devonshire Street, Mission Hills, CA 91345

✨ New to hiking? You’re still welcome! No need to be a hardcore hiker — just bring your good vibes, plenty of water, and comfortable hiking shoes. Everyone is welcome, and leashed dogs are invited, too!

⚠️ Legal Note:By attending this event, you acknowledge and agree that participation in the hike is at your own risk. This event is an informal, voluntary gathering,
